scorer_commit: The score_context.py and node_jobs.py that ran are byte-identical to scripts/score_context.py and scripts/node_jobs.py in this tree at commits adfdb3d, 09d8f53 and HEAD; neither file changed across that range.
written_by_hand: This run was made on a hosted notebook that holds no copy of the repository, so record_run.py could not record it. The manifest is assembled from what the notebook returned; node.json is the scorer's own account of its environment and its cells, and score.log is the slice of the runner's console log that belongs to this job.
host: Google Colab, free tier, Linux x86_64, Python 3.13.15
gpu: NVIDIA Tesla T4, 15.64 GB, CUDA 12.8, torch 2.11.0+cu128
command: python score_context.py 2026-09-12-lc-2015h1e-folds --out-dir 2026-09-12-lc-2015h1e-folds-scored-tabicl-t1-check --models tabicl --temperature 1.0 --nearest 1 --seeds 20260911 --chunk 20000, run by node_jobs.py from the unpacked job archive as job 2 of 2
sibling_job: tabicl@2026-09-12-lc-2015h1e-folds, recorded at experiments/2026-09-13-lc-2015h1e-folds-tabicl-colab-t4; no separate index directory was made for this two-job archive.

job_archive.built_by: scripts/pack_node_run.py over experiments/2026-09-12-lc-2015h1e-folds, as a zip for the notebook's upload cell; sidecars outoftime-run-folds-2015h1e-tabicl.zip.sha256 and .jobs.json beside it.
job_archive.score_context_py_provenance: Hash of the copy inside the archive, LF-ended; equal to scripts/score_context.py in this tree at commits adfdb3d, 09d8f53 and HEAD.

result_archive.name: outoftime-result-folds-2015h1e-tabicl.zip
result_archive.contents: 2026-09-12-lc-2015h1e-folds-scored-tabicl-t1-check/ (node.json, scores.parquet, reference.parquet, parts/) and folds.log, jobs.json, jobs-done.json; 20 files total

bundle_check.how: The hashes the scorer recorded in node.json for the bundle it read equal bundle.json of experiments/2026-09-12-lc-2015h1e-folds. The scorer refuses a bundle whose hashes differ from bundle.json, so the notebook scored the recorded rows.

parts_check: 2 part files under parts/, one per (model, context seed, cell), equal to the 2 cell records of node.json; the parts concatenated are scores.parquet and reference.parquet row for row and probability for probability.

row_check.scored: 20,000 rows for context seed 20260911, cohort fold1-test; every (cohort, row) pair, its outcome and its age match the gbm rows of experiments/2026-09-12-lc-2015h1e-folds/scored.parquet, zero mismatches, no missing probability
row_check.reference: 50,000 rows per context seed; every row and its outcome match the gbm-50k reference of the same context seed in experiments/2026-09-12-lc-2015h1e-folds/reference.parquet, zero mismatches

console_log: score.log is the runner's console output for this job, sliced from folds.log. Read in full.
question_this_run_was_sent_to_answer: The derivation check for this fold bundle: one cell of one context draw scored by the library at softmax temperature 1.0, so that derive_temperature.py can derive the 1.0 rows of the rest of this bundle from the rows at the shipped 0.9 and refuse unless its derivation agrees with these rows to 1e-6.

what_it_measured.model: tabicl 2.1.1, checkpoint tabicl-classifier-v2-20260212.ckpt (sha256 bdc7dbd5...4ed0) downloaded from Hugging Face by the library, tabpfn not installed
what_it_measured.chunk: 20,000 scored rows per forward call (--chunk 20000); rows are scored independently and the chunking changes no probability
what_it_measured.cells: 1 cohort cell (fold1-test) of 20,000 rows and one reference cell, seed 20260911 only
what_it_measured.timing: This job ran on a hosted, shared free-tier notebook, not a dedicated node; the seconds node.json records for each cell are the scorer's own timer reading on whatever the host gave the process that second and are not a quotable performance measurement. They are kept in node.json unedited.

tuning_budget: Zero trials, no validation split, every parameter at the library default except those the command names. The classical models this is paired with (fold 1 of experiments/2026-09-12-lc-2015h1e-folds/folds.json) were tuned on their own pool, and the asymmetry runs both ways.
not_in_this_run: The fold1-validation cell at 1.0: derived, not scored, from the tabicl job's 0.9 rows. TabPFN, scored on a separate node.
